title: XTRIME – Arctic Mint
description:
Love minty flavor and want to refresh Then EXTREME ARCTIC MINT is perfect for you.

It will allow you to experience unforgettable sensations that you will want to repeat again and again

EXTREME ARCTIC MINT is one of the best mint flavored nicotine pouches in the world. It has a strong strength and provides an ice effect of incredible power.

This is what creates a very long pleasant aftertaste and refreshing breath. Together with it, the buzz will be felt not only by you, but also by those around you!

Portion size: 0,8g
Nicotine: 16mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 12,8mg
Portions in one package: 20 pc
